text.p: These are the main headlines reported by Radio Latvia on Monday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.

- Around 100 Vainode district residents protested the closure of the local railway line, blocking rails for the straight second day. The line to the port city of Liepaja has been deemed unviable by Latvian Railways.
- The foreign relations committees of the Baltic parliaments will hold a three-day meeting on the Estonian island of Saaremaa, starting on August 28.
